response:
下方表单默认关闭明细；关闭时“明细条件”的值仍保留，只是不显示，也不参与必填校验。提交按钮只会生成一份可编辑草稿，绝不会自动发送。

```kelivo-ui
ui 1 catalog "kelivo.native/1"
root = Column(children=[form,ask])
$on: boolean = false
$name: string = ""
$detail: string = "保留内容"
form = Form(children=[toggle,nameField,detailField], title="机构报销条件")
toggle = Switch(label="启用明细条件", bind=$on)
nameField = TextField(label="机构名称", bind=$name, required=true, placeholder="请输入机构名称")
detailField = TextField(label="明细条件", bind=$detail, required=true, visible=$on, placeholder="请输入明细条件")
ask = Button(label="准备检查草稿", form=form, action=Ask(text="请检查这份机构报销条件表单的可编辑草稿（尚未发送）。", context={"name":$name,"enabled":$on,"detail":$detail}))
```
